owned_invariants: integers reads a list whose every entry is an exact integer as those integers. A decimal, a boolean, text, a nested list, or a value that is not a list is read as nothing.
object gives back a reply that is an object. Any other reply stops the run as a malformed candidate, with the stage in the reason.

integers_under reads the list of exact integers under a key of a reply. A missing key, or anything under it that is not such a list, stops the run as a malformed candidate, with the key in the reason.
squared_norm is the sum of the squares of a list as an exact integer of any size. The empty list has norm zero.
boundaries: A reading says what a reply holds, not that it is right. Each family judges what it reads.
The reasons are words for a person. No family's refusal code depends on them.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
